## Modules

.claude/ape/ape_hook.py
examples/demo/apps/__init__.py — Container package for the demo apps.
examples/demo/apps/blog/__init__.py
examples/demo/apps/blog/api/__init__.py
examples/demo/apps/blog/api/urls.py — Blog API routes — discovered by autodiscover_urls("api").
examples/demo/apps/blog/apps.py — AppConfig for the demo blog app (the apps.py marker autoload looks for).
examples/demo/apps/blog/signals.py — Auto-imported by django-autoload on ready() — no manual import needed.
examples/demo/apps/shop/__init__.py
examples/demo/apps/shop/api/__init__.py
examples/demo/apps/shop/api/urls.py — Shop API routes — discovered by autodiscover_urls("api").
examples/demo/apps/shop/apps.py — AppConfig for the demo shop app (the apps.py marker autoload looks for).
examples/demo/apps/shop/signals.py — Auto-imported by django-autoload on ready() — no manual import needed.
examples/demo/demo_project/__init__.py
examples/demo/demo_project/settings.py — Minimal Django settings for the django-autoload demo project.
examples/demo/demo_project/urls.py — URL configuration — assembled by auto-discovery.
examples/demo/manage.py
scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/quality_gate.py
src/django_autoload/__init__.py — django-autoload — convention-over-configuration auto-discovery for Django.
src/django_autoload/apps.py — AppConfig that wires component auto-loading into Django's startup.
src/django_autoload/checks.py — Django system checks validating the autoload configuration.
src/django_autoload/components.py — Per-app component loading (signals, receivers, checks, ...).
src/django_autoload/conf.py — Configuration resolution for django-autoload.
src/django_autoload/discovery.py — App discovery: locate app packages and build ``INSTALLED_APPS`` entries.
src/django_autoload/jobs.py — Optional RQ extra: import every discovered app's job module.
src/django_autoload/routers.py — Optional DRF extra: aggregate per-app routers into a single one.
src/django_autoload/settings.py — Settings fragment loading and merging.
src/django_autoload/tasks.py — Optional Celery extra: point Celery at every discovered app.
src/django_autoload/urls.py — URL auto-discovery driven by the ``URL_PATTERNS`` configuration mapping.
tests/conftest.py — Pytest fixtures: configure a minimal Django and a synthetic project tree.
tests/test_checks.py — Tests for the Django system checks in :mod:`django_autoload.checks`.
tests/test_discovery.py — Tests covering app, url, settings and component discovery.
tests/test_extras.py — Tests for the optional DRF and Celery extras (skipped if deps absent).
tests/test_settings_components.py — Tests for per-app settings discovery and package-style components.
